name: trouble
description: Stop looping on a bug you cannot close. /trouble is a four-minds debug protocol — Data, Sherlock Holmes, Linus Torvalds, and Brian Cox — that ranks hypotheses with Bayesian math and refuses a fix until they unanimously agree.

interface.shortDescription: Four-minds debug protocol for stuck incidents
interface.longDescription: Installs the /trouble skill: Data, Sherlock Holmes, Linus Torvalds, and Brian Cox collect evidence, rank hypotheses with Bayesian arithmetic, and refuse a fix until they unanimously agree. Ships a machine-parseable TROUBLE_VERDICT block for incident response and debug loops.
